lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white spots arranged in a structured grid pattern posterior to the gill slits, featuring a prominent vertical column of approximately five larger circular blobs midway along the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs to form a visible grid-like coordinate system across the central lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with higher pixel values on the dorsal edge and a shadow gradient on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a sparse distribution of roughly 6 to 10 distinct high-luminance blobs scattered across its lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density cluster of small, high-luminance spots that are significantly reduced in size compared to the primary flank constellation.
